g.text: PX4 Sensor-to-EKF Execution Map (NuttX, single-estimator example)
Where the execution loops live, and how data travels from kernel/driver to PX4 modules
Hardware & NuttX services — flat build, shared address space
Flat build: one shared address space. This is a logical responsibility split, not a protected user/kernel boundary.
uORB topic storage — retained typed data + notifications; NOT a thread

text.tspan: • publish copies data into topic storage
• callback usually calls ScheduleNow() on subscriber work item
• consumer runs later in its worker and reads data
• there is no central uORB broker thread
• PX4 worker threads are not NuttX HPWORK/LPWORK
• DRDY schedules the driver, not EKF
• GNSS does not wake EKF in this path
NuttX scheduler, semaphores, interrupts, device drivers
PX4 wq:* worker threads are separate from HPWORK / LPWORK
VehicleIMU and EKF2 share one thread
wait for bytes → parse → publish → repeat
